title: The Five Faces of Light and the Five Worlds of Darkness
description: A paired meditation on the Lord's fivefold going-forth and the proprium's matching articulation. T5 expounds four faces by which the Lord goes forth toward the soul — Divine Human, accommodated revelation, illumining wisdom, conjugate movement of summons and answer — each met by a counterpart of self-claiming. T6 anatomizes self-love arranging the natural mind in five complete aspects, each with its own ruling claim, body, taste, and pairing of active/receptive — the proprium taking on a parodic five-degree articulation of the rational's five degrees. The teachings show that wherever the Lord goes forth in five, the proprium has organized five matching forms.
